purpose.summary: Logo files for the Holiday Light Spectacular, ready to use on the web, in documents, and in QR codes.
goals: Use the supplied logo files so the Holiday Light Spectacular looks the same everywhere.
Give staff and partners a white and a transparent version to choose from.

generalRules: Use the supplied artwork. Do not recolor, stretch, or redraw the logo.
Leave clear space around the logo and do not overlap it with other graphics.

variants.name: Logo, white background
variants.description: Round yellow logo with red Holiday Light Spectacular lettering and a string of colored lights, on a white background.
variants.usage: Use in documents, slides, and web pages with a white or light background.

variants.name: Logo, transparent background
variants.description: The same logo with nothing behind the circle.
variants.usage: Use on colored pages or over other artwork, where a white box around the logo would not fit.

qrCodeLogos.guidance: The default is the round logo on a transparent square. Use it for the center of a QR code.

items.name: QR code logo
items.description: Round Holiday Light Spectacular logo on a transparent square.
items.usage: Use as the logo in the center of a QR code for the Holiday Light Spectacular.

guidance.primaryPalette: Yellow and red are the main colors in the logo.
guidance.secondaryPalette: Green, purple, orange, and charcoal appear in the string of lights.
guidance.continuity: These colors were taken from the logo artwork, not from a style guide. Use the supplied logo files rather than re-creating them from these values.

guidance: No typography guidance has been provided for this brand yet.

fileFormats.masterArtworkRule: Use the supplied files as they are. Do not recolor, stretch, or redraw them.

print.description: Only PNG files are available right now. Ask for a larger or vector file before printing at large sizes.

webElectronic.description: Use the transparent PNG on colored or photo backgrounds, and the white-background PNG everywhere else.

publicationNotes: The logo was supplied as an image file with a white background. The transparent version was made from it by removing the white around the circle.
Colors were sampled from the logo image and are approximate.
No style guide, owner, or website has been provided for this brand yet.
